function sqlText(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}

function sqlNumber(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? String(parsed) : 'NULL';
}

function sqlBoolean(value) {
  return value ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
}

function sqlJson(value) {
  const json = JSON.stringify(value ?? {});
  return "'" + json.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb";
}

const items = $input.all();

return items.map((item) => {
  const row = item.json;
  const sgcSyncRequired = Boolean(row.completed_data);
  const sgcSyncStatus = sgcSyncRequired ? 'ready' : 'pending';

  const query = [
    'INSERT INTO public.waba_leads (',
    '  chatwoot_account_id,',
    '  chatwoot_inbox_id,',
    '  chatwoot_conversation_id,',
    '  chatwoot_contact_id,',
    '  contact_name,',
    '  phone,',
    '  email,',
    '  identification,',
    '  city,',
    '  conversation_status,',
    '  conversation_created_at,',
    '  last_message_at,',
    '  first_user_message,',
    '  assignee_name,',
    '  team_name,',
    '  selected_model,',
    '  latest_selected_model,',
    '  first_message_model_detected,',
    '  first_message_model_matches_selected,',
    '  appointment_date,',
    '  appointment_time,',
    '  advisor_name,',
    '  lead_status,',
    '  lead_source,',
    '  report_date,',
    '  report_start_at,',
    '  report_end_at,',
    '  labels,',
    '  custom_attributes,',
    '  additional_attributes,',
    '  raw_payload,',
    '  sgc_sync_status,',
    '  sgc_sync_required',
    ') VALUES (',
    '  ' + sqlNumber(row.account_id) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlNumber(row.inbox_id) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlNumber(row.conversation_id) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlNumber(row.contact_id) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.name) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.number) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.email) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.identifier) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.city) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.conversation_status) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.created_at) + '::timestamptz,',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.last_activity_at) + '::timestamptz,',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.first_user_message_text) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.assignee_name) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.team_name) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.model) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.latest_selected_model) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.first_message_model_detected) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlBoolean(row.first_message_model_matches_selected) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.appointment_date) + '::date,',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.appointment_time) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.advisor_name) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.lead_status) + ',',
    "  'waba_chatwoot',",
    '  ' + sqlText(row.report_date) + '::date,',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.report_start_at) + '::timestamptz,',
    '  ' + sqlText(row.report_end_at) + '::timestamptz,',
    '  ' + sqlJson(row.labels ?? []) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlJson(row.custom_attributes ?? {}) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlJson(row.additional_attributes ?? {}) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlJson(row.raw_payload ?? {}) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlText(sgcSyncStatus) + ',',
    '  ' + sqlBoolean(sgcSyncRequired),
    ')',
    'ON CONFLICT (chatwoot_account_id, chatwoot_conversation_id, report_date)',
    'DO UPDATE SET',
    '  chatwoot_inbox_id = EXCLUDED.chatwoot_inbox_id,',
    '  chatwoot_contact_id = EXCLUDED.chatwoot_contact_id,',
    '  contact_name = EXCLUDED.contact_name,',
    '  phone = EXCLUDED.phone,',
    '  email = EXCLUDED.email,',
    '  identification = EXCLUDED.identification,',
    '  city = EXCLUDED.city,',
    '  conversation_status = EXCLUDED.conversation_status,',
    '  conversation_created_at = EXCLUDED.conversation_created_at,',
    '  last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at,',
    '  first_user_message = EXCLUDED.first_user_message,',
    '  assignee_name = EXCLUDED.assignee_name,',
    '  team_name = EXCLUDED.team_name,',
    '  selected_model = EXCLUDED.selected_model,',
    '  latest_selected_model = EXCLUDED.latest_selected_model,',
    '  first_message_model_detected = EXCLUDED.first_message_model_detected,',
    '  first_message_model_matches_selected = EXCLUDED.first_message_model_matches_selected,',
    '  appointment_date = EXCLUDED.appointment_date,',
    '  appointment_time = EXCLUDED.appointment_time,',
    '  advisor_name = EXCLUDED.advisor_name,',
    '  lead_status = EXCLUDED.lead_status,',
    '  lead_source = EXCLUDED.lead_source,',
    '  report_start_at = EXCLUDED.report_start_at,',
    '  report_end_at = EXCLUDED.report_end_at,',
    '  labels = EXCLUDED.labels,',
    '  custom_attributes = EXCLUDED.custom_attributes,',
    '  additional_attributes = EXCLUDED.additional_attributes,',
    '  raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,',
    '  sgc_sync_required = public.waba_leads.sgc_sync_required OR EXCLUDED.sgc_sync_required,',
    '  updated_at = now();',
  ].join('\n');

  return {
    json: {
      ...row,
      sgc_sync_required: sgcSyncRequired,
      sgc_sync_status: sgcSyncStatus,
      upsert_query: query,
    },
  };
});
